main.description: Deletes the secrets dev.knotless.putSecret left for a repository the caller owns, or administers as an organization's admin who joined: those of a name, those sealed to a runner, or both; with neither, all of the repository's. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the appview's DID, for this method, or the appview's own pages' login, as their writes take it.

name.description: Only the secret of this name, for every runner.

owner.description: The repository's owner; absent, the caller. Another account only when the caller is an admin who joined it as an organization.

repo.description: The repository's key, as its dev.knotless.repo record holds it.

runner.description: Only those sealed to this runner.

deleted.description: How many were deleted, one for each runner a name was sealed to.
